_note: SYNTHETIC scorer test input - hand-written, not model output. Every requirement found, cited and quoted correctly.

requirements.title: Book a consultation room
requirements.text: Receptionists book a consultation room for a named clinician and a time slot.

evidence.quote: Receptionists must be able to book a consultation room for a named clinician and a time slot

requirements.title: Prevent overlapping bookings
requirements.text: The system rejects a booking of the same room for overlapping time slots.

evidence.quote: The system must prevent two bookings of the same room for overlapping time slots

requirements.title: View own weekly bookings
requirements.text: Clinicians view their own bookings for the coming week.

evidence.quote: Clinicians must be able to view their own bookings for the coming week

requirements.title: Email booking confirmation to clinician
requirements.text: The system emails the clinician a confirmation when a booking is created.

evidence.quote: The system must send a confirmation email to the clinician when a booking is created
When a booking is made, the clinician receives an email confirming it

requirements.title: Offer earliest room to priority patients
requirements.text: Priority patients are offered the earliest available room.

evidence.quote: Priority patients must be offered the earliest available room

requirements.title: Receptionists delete mistaken bookings
requirements.text: Receptionists delete bookings that were created by mistake.

evidence.quote: Receptionists may delete bookings that were created by mistake

requirements.title: Cancel a booking
requirements.text: Receptionists cancel a booking up to 24 hours before its start time.

evidence.quote: Receptionists must be able to cancel a booking up to 24 hours before its start time

requirements.title: Record cancellations
requirements.text: The system records who cancelled a booking and when.

evidence.quote: The system must record who cancelled a booking and when

requirements.title: Manage staff accounts
requirements.text: Administrators create, disable and re-enable staff accounts.

evidence.quote: Administrators must be able to create, disable and re-enable staff accounts

requirements.title: Take a deposit for private consultations
requirements.text: Patients pay a deposit when a room is booked for a private consultation.

evidence.quote: Patients pay a deposit when a room is booked for a private consultation
The booking page must load within 2 seconds for 95% of requests
The system must support at least 50 concurrent users

requirements.title: Monthly availability
requirements.text: The system is available each calendar month.

evidence.quote: The system must be available 99.5% of the time each calendar month

requirements.title: Password length
requirements.text: Staff passwords have a minimum length.

evidence.quote: Staff passwords must be at least 12 characters long
